result.narrative:
Intel Corporation sits in the Watch band with a score of 20.7 and a PD of 0.1072. The payment side of the ledger is clean: 0 days past due and a zero weighted payment contribution, so there is no evidence of actual payment deterioration. The entire Watch score is generated by a single severity-3 news item, a shareholder lawsuit following a 29% stock plunge (Reuters, Nov 16), which carries a decayed weight of 59.2 and feeds the 20.7 composite score (0.35 x 59.2).

The band placement rests solely on that one legal/reputational article, which is itself only a bare headline with no detail on the lawsuit's substance, size, or likely financial impact. The adjudicator agreed with the Watch call but flagged caveats: more recent articles (age_days 0-4) show Intel shares rallying 13% and 7% and the company landing its first external 18A/18A-P foundry customers, a trend the scoring formula does not net against the single worst-article trigger. With news alone holding the band and a 365-day half-life, this lawsuit-driven score will persist for some time unless reassessed.

Given the clean payment history, in-appetite PD (0.1072 vs 0.25 target), and no change to expected loss (540,288 before and after), the recommendation is to MAINTAIN the current limit of 7,000,000 USD for Tamrin Exports under policy TCI-EX-2026-0001, with no change in exposure (owed is 0). This is a maintain-and-monitor case rather than a restrict action, consistent with the adjudicator's agree-with-caveats view that risk is overstated by the single-article methodology but not absent.

The buyer is close to the lower Healthy band (0.7 points away) and would move there if the news effect fades or is reassessed in light of the positive operational developments; continued 0 DPD performance supports this. Conversely, the buyer would need to deteriorate materially to reach High Risk (29.3 points away, or payment delinquency reaching 38 days past due) before the next band threshold of 50.0 is hit.

judgement.bottom_line: Maintain the current 7,000,000 USD limit for Intel Corporation; the Watch band is driven entirely by one severity-3 shareholder-lawsuit headline rather than any payment deterioration, and the adjudicator agreed with the Watch score but flagged that more recent positive news (stock rally, new foundry customers) is not reflected in the formula.

worsens_it: Score rising 29.3 points to 50.0 would trigger High Risk
